Frontend: Playwright login → /apps/app_e3cb4f084785 verified header (label-tenant-name), Overview card title (label-overview-card-title) and description (label-overview-card-desc) all follow appDoc.name/description and update ~10s after a background PATCH via the 8s poll (marker 'Iter54UIBrand96297' + 'Iter54UISub1788896297' all rendered live), then restored cleanly to 'Lumen Events Co.'. Verified: (1) navbar.brand → apps.name → both Overview card title and header, (2) hero.subtitle → apps.description → card desc, (3) hero.description takes precedence over subtitle when both exist, (4) a saved ui_labels tenant override for overview_card_title does NOT shadow the live apps.name (frontend reads appDoc.name directly, backend sync_overview keeps mirroring brand), (5) apps.industry stays the niche label across all 4 tenants after hero PATCH with a badge-like string — badge never becomes industry, tags array untouched, (6) cross-tenant brand+subtitle sync passes for all 4 seeded tenants (app_e3cb4f084785, app_6663b5de0007, app_abc693a75574, app_1cb6f2b89eb6), (7) GET /api/public/landing/tenants still returns names + industries/tags, (8) POST /api/apps/{id}/site/sync-overview still returns 200 with fresh snapshot. No 'Maximum update depth exceeded', no console errors beyond a benign Canvas2D willReadFrequently warning. All modified hero/navbar content restored in each test's finally block.
critical_code_review_comments: OverviewPanel.jsx now bypasses <L> for card title/desc — this is correct for the sync requirement, but the small helper copy 'Click any label to rename it…' at the top of the panel is now slightly misleading for those two fields specifically (they can't be renamed independently anymore). Consider tightening the hint to 'Chip/button labels only; the Overview title & summary now follow Site Mode'.

content_lock.sync_overview() writes apps.name AND apps.description on every save. If an admin manually edits description via PATCH /api/apps/{id} without touching Site Mode, the next Site Mode save silently overwrites it. That is by design per the spec ('area also gets changed automatically'), but worth surfacing near the description field so admins aren't surprised, mirroring the same call-out I raised in iter53 for name.

sync_overview's 'description' selector iterates keys ('description','body','text','lead','blurb') in that order — good for hero blocks, but if a hero happens to have both a non-empty 'description' AND a legacy 'body', 'description' wins (expected). Just document this precedence somewhere in-code.

The description fallback chain uses `description or snap['subtitle']` — if a hero has description='' (empty string), it falls through to subtitle. Correct today, but a whitespace-only description ('   ') would win and produce an empty-looking Overview desc. Consider stripping before the truthy check.

No API endpoint verifies that ui_labels overrides for overview_card_title/overview_card_description/header_tenant_name are ignored by the frontend — a lingering override in DB is now dead data. A one-time cleanup migration (delete these three keys from ui_overrides across tenants) would keep the collection clean; the previous agent's manual cleanup handled today's tenants but new stale rows can still be created via the labels API.
